question: Who among the following was the first person to discuss poverty line in pre - independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was the first person to **discuss poverty line** in pre-independent India.
 
• He was a prominent **Indian nationalist **and the first Indian to be **elected **to the British Parliament.
 
• Naoroji coined the term **"poverty line"** in his book** "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India" **published in **1901.**
 
• His book highlighted the** exploitation of India** by the British and the **economic drain of wealth** from India to Britain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahalanobis** was an **Indian statistician **who developed the **Mahalanobis distance** and was a key figure in the development of the **Indian statistical system. **
 
• **Dr. BR Ambedkar **was a** social reformer** and the **chief architect **of the Indian Constitution.
 
• **RK Shanmukham Chetty** was an **Indian lawyer and politician **who served as the** first finance minister** of independent India.
 
• Hence, the **correct** answer is option 1.
